jobs.title: People Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories that help aerospace and defense companies manufacture rockets, satellites, jets, and ships up to 10x faster and up to 2x cheaper. By combining advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we are reinventing how America produces its most critical parts.

We’re accelerating our mission with the launch of Factory 3 in Mesa, Arizona, a 290,000-square-foot facility creating 350 new jobs. We are expanding rapidly to support thousands of future hires, launching Hadrian Maritime to expand into naval production, and introducing a Factory-as-a-Service model that delivers complete systems instead of individual parts.

Hadrian is backed by leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, and Andreessen Horowitz, our fast-growing team is united around reindustrializing American manufacturing for the 21st century and beyond.

The Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and mission-driven People Data Analyst to join our People team. In this role, you’ll be the connective tissue between People Systems, Data Engineering, and People leadership, translating raw People and business data into the insights that shape how we hire, organize, and grow.

You’ll partner closely with our People Systems Engineer and Data Engineering team to help define the data model that underpins our People stack, and you’ll own turning that foundation into dashboards, reports, and analysis that recruiting, People leadership, and the broader business leadership team rely on to make decisions.

This is a build-from-the-ground-up opportunity: you won’t inherit a mature analytics function with years of dashboards and definitions already in place. You’ll help define what “good” looks like, the metrics that matter, the data model that supports them, and the reporting infrastructure that scales with a hypergrowth company. You’ll also help define how AI augments this work, from automating recurring reporting to building natural-language interfaces over People data in partnership with People Systems.

What You’ll Do

Design and build dashboards and self-serve reporting (e.g. in Tableau, Superset) once the underlying data infrastructure is in place, and own their accuracy and adoption going forward
Define and standardize core People metrics time-to-fill, attrition, span of control, headcount vs. plan, and similar in partnership with People leadership
Translate business questions from People and Recruiting leadership, and executive stakeholders into clear analytical approaches, and deliver insights that directly inform decisions
Partner with the People Systems Engineer and Data Engineering team to define and evolve the People data model
Connect People data to broader business metrics (e.g. headcount vs. revenue or production output, productivity, cost per hire relative to business growth) to give business leadership a complete picture of how people investment tracks with company performance
Partner with People Systems to identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI and natural language interfaces to make People data more accessible; helping non-technical stakeholders query and explore data without needing to build a new report each time
Own data quality and governance for People analytics; establishing definitions, validating accuracy, and ensuring leadership can trust the numbers without having to double-check them
Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses (e.g. attrition drivers, hiring funnel efficiency, organizational design) that go beyond standard reporting to answer emerging business questions

What We’re Looking For

6+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or people analytics, with a track record of delivering insights that influenced real business or People decisions
Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly in a modern data warehouse (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) to build and maintain your own queries and data models, rather than relying solely on pre-built tables
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in a BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, Superset including the underlying data modeling, not just the visualization layer
Experience partnering with engineering or data engineering teams to define data models and requirements - you can speak both “business question” and “data model” fluently
Demonstrated experience with core People/HR metrics and the employee lifecycle including recruiting funnel, headcount planning, attrition, compensation, performance and how they’re typically modeled
Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment — you can define your own roadmap in partnership with stakeholders rather than waiting for fully-scoped requirements

What Will Set You Apart

Direct experience partnering with a People Systems or engineering function to define a Peopledata model from the ground up
Experience with Rippling or similar HRIS platforms, and familiarity with how ATS, finance, and workforce data typically integrate with HR systems
Experience using AI tools (e.g. LLM-powered analysis, natural language querying over structured data, AI-assisted reporting) to scale analytics work and reduce manual reporting burden
Experience supporting People analytics in manufacturing, defense, or other complex multi- population environments (e.g. exempt and non-exempt populations across multiple sites)
Prior experience as the first or founding People analytics hire at a high-growth company, building reporting infrastructure rather than maintaining an existing one

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is 150,000 - 170,000
(actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Benefits For Full-time Employees

Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees
401k
Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need.
Flexible vacation policy
Equity

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. About Our Job

With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver (CCD) means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver. Click here to find out about all the amazing benefits and reasons to work for CCD!

New hires are typically brought into the organization with a starting pay between $60,064-72,000/year, based on education and experience. Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance (effective within 1 month of start date)

Location & Schedule

The City and County of Denver supports a hybrid workplace model. Employees work where needed, at a job site several days a week and off-site as needed. In this position you can expect to work 3 days per week on site
at Denver International Airport, 8500 Pena Blvd. Denver, CO 80249. Employees must work within the state of Colorado on their off-site days.

Who We Are & What You’ll Do

Denver International Airport (DEN) is the third-busiest airport in the United States and one of the top ten busiest airports in the world, connecting our community globally through flight and business. DEN is the primary economic engine for the state of Colorado, generating more than $47.2 billion for the region annually and employing nearly 37,000 people. At DEN, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace. We celebrate individuality and uplift all races, ethnicities, gender identities, national origins, ages, abilities, religion, and LGBTQIA+ communities. We know that our diversity makes us stronger, and we strive to keep diversity, equity and inclusion at the center of all that we do.

The Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Analyst supports geospatial technologies at Denver International Airport (DEN) by maintaining authoritative spatial data; supporting enterprise GIS applications; and assisting with the administration and optimization of DEN’s geospatial platform. This isn't your traditional GIS role! You'll support a complex airport environment where your work directly influences infrastructure, operations, planning, and emergency response. You'll see the impact of your work in the field while helping modernize DEN's geospatial systems through automation and enterprise GIS initiatives.

This position contributes to the continued development of ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Indoors, and supports airport divisions by maintaining spatial databases; publishing and troubleshooting GIS services; developing web-based GIS solutions; and helping integrate geospatial data with critical airport systems.

The ideal candidate is detail oriented, collaborative, technically curious, and comfortable working in an enterprise GIS environment. This person should be able to maintain high-quality spatial datasets; support Portal and Server-based GIS applications; contribute to indoor mapping and airport infrastructure workflows; and communicate technical GIS concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical users.

Key responsibilities will include:

Develop and maintain authoritative geospatial datasets to ensure accuracy, reliability, and alignment with operational needs.
Conduct spatial analysis to support airport operations, planning, design, construction, facilities, environmental management, safety, emergency response, and strategic decision-making.
Design, configure, and maintain web maps, dashboards, reports, and interactive GIS applications through ArcGIS Enterprise Portal, ArcGIS Online, Experience Builder, Dashboards, Field Maps, Survey123, SiteScan, and other related Esri tools.
Publish, configure, and maintain GIS services, including hosted and referenced feature layers, map image layers, web maps, and other ArcGIS Server-based services.
Support ArcGIS Enterprise Portal content management, including item documentation, sharing permissions, groups, metadata, naming standards, and retirement of outdated content.
Support ArcGIS Server service configuration, including capabilities, sharing settings, editor tracking, sync, pop-ups, symbology, labeling, scale visibility, and data refresh workflows.
Coordinate updates to the Airport Layout Plan and related airport datasets, collaborating with internal stakeholders to support accuracy, consistency, and FAA compliance.
Assist with updates to ArcGIS Indoors derived from CAD, BIM, as-built drawings, stakeholder input, and space management information.
Support CAD-to-GIS and BIM-to-GIS workflows for facility information, airport infrastructure, and indoor spaces.
Create and maintain Arcade expressions to support labeling, symbology, pop-ups, and user experience environments.
Assist in administering GIS platforms, including user management, troubleshooting, and system updates.
Ensure compliance with FAA, GIS, and IT standards, data governance policies, cybersecurity requirements, accessibility standards, and best practices.
Assist in integrating GIS technology with enterprise applications to improve workflow automation, data accessibility, reporting, and decision-making processes.
Provide technical guidance, GIS training, documentation, and end-user support to staff and stakeholders.
Stay current with emerging GIS technologies, Esri platform capabilities, and geospatial trends to enhance system capabilities.

What You’ll Bring

We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience and exemplify this through the makeup of our team at all levels. You'll be right at home here if you cultivate strong relationships and push yourself, your work, the people around you and Denver to the next level.

We are seeking a geospatial professional who is eager to learn and contribute to the dynamic environment of a large and complex airport environment; and who understands the importance that maintaining existing infrastructure is crucial for the development goals of our airport.

Our ideal candidate has some or all the following experience, skills, and characteristics:

Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, such as Portal for ArcGIS, ArcGIS Server, enterprise service publishing, and content management, is highly preferred.
Ability to communicate technical GIS concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience evaluating existing policies, procedures, and objectives, and recommending changes for improvement.
Experience with the Esri software suite.
Experience maintaining GIS data in structure databases, enterprise geodatabases, relational databases, or multi-user editing environments.
Familiarity with automation tools such as FME, Python, Arcade, SQL, ModelBuilder, or other scripting and data processing is preferred but not required.
Familiarity with Autodesk products (Civil 3D, AutoCAD) is preferred but not required.
Knowledge of FAA regulations and airport operations is desired but not required.
IT background is helpful but not required. Candidates with experience in information technology, database administration, systems support, automation, or enterprise application administration are encouraged to apply if you also have experience working with GIS platforms.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Required Minimum Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Geography, Urban Planning, Engineering, GIS, Geology, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cartography, Landscape Architecture, Remote Sensing or a related field.
Experience requirement: Two (2) years of hands-on experience at the type and level of a GIS Technician.
Education & Experience Equivalency: One (1) year of the appropriate type and level of experience may be substituted for each required year of post-high school education.
A completed certification of any of the following: GES (Geography and Environmental Science) or GIS&T (Geographical Information Science and Technology) or GIS (Geographic Information Systems) will be an acceptable substitution.
Additional appropriate education may be substituted for the minimum experience requirements.

Application Deadline

Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than Sunday, July 19th, 2026, at 11:59pm to ensure consideration.

FBI Background Check: FBI criminal background check is required for all positions at Denver International Airport (DEN). Employees are also required to report any felony convictions and/or moving violations to maintain this clearance and be eligible for continued employment. By position, a pre-employment physical/drug test may be required.

Snow / Emergency Duties: Denver International Airport is a 24/7/365 team operation. If weather conditions warrant or an emergency crisis occurs, all DEN employees can be required to work extended hours and/or shifts.

Advanced English language skills, both written and verbal, to include technical writing/editing experience and a demonstrated ability to write, edit, and deliver planning content.

Creative problem-solving skills to gather relevant information to solve less well-defined planning problems.

Igniters operate in the world’s most demanding environment. Igniters are self-motivated, mission-driven, and relentless in solving the Warfighters’ hardest problems. Ignite exists to outpace the threat and deliver results that matter in the moments that count.

Ignite is hiring an experienced Data Engineer/Data Analyst with an active SECRET clearance to support the government customer in Huntsville, Alabama.

Job Requirements

Position Overview

Under the guidance of the Program Manager, the Data Engineer/Data Analyst supports data engineering, analytics, reporting, and decision-support initiatives in a secure Department of War (DoW) environment. This position is responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and optimizing data solutions primarily within the Army Vantage Platform, while also leveraging Power BI for visualization, reporting, and integration with enterprise data products.

The Data Engineer/Data Analyst will partner with mission stakeholders, analysts, developers, and platform teams through all phases of the data and analytics lifecycle, including requirements analysis, data ingestion, transformation, modeling, validation, visualization, troubleshooting, and sustainment. This role helps enable authoritative, scalable, and secure data products that improve operational insight, business intelligence, and decision-making across multiple Line of Business initiatives.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions, Responsibilities, and Duties

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Analyze business requirements, functional requirements, and data specifications to design and develop scalable data and analytics solutions.
Design, build, and maintain data pipelines, curated data assets, analytical models, and reporting solutions within the Army Vantage Platform.
Develop and support dashboards, reports, workflows, and operational data products for mission and business users.
Leverage Power BI to create visualizations, dashboards, and executive-level reporting solutions using trusted and governed data sources.
Perform data transformation, cleansing, normalization, and enrichment across structured and semi-structured data sources.
Design and implement logical and physical data models that support reporting, analysis, and operational use cases.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, procedures, and transformations to support data integration and reporting requirements.
Troubleshoot data pipelines, analytics workflows, dashboards, and platform issues, including timely resolution of production problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, acquire, validate, and govern data from multiple authoritative sources.
Support data quality, data lineage, data governance, and traceability requirements across analytics solutions.
Prepare, model, visualize, and analyze data to provide meaningful reporting and decision-support capabilities aligned to customer and mission needs.
Incorporate DoW security requirements, access controls, and data protection measures into analytics and modernization efforts.
Participate in architecture discussions, solution reviews, and platform improvement efforts related to Army Vantage, Power BI, SQL-based systems, and enterprise data environments.
Develop, document, and implement data models for transactional systems, reporting solutions, dashboards, and enterprise analytics products.
Produce clear technical documentation, user guidance, and solution artifacts to support sustainment and knowledge transfer.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and deliver clear, accurate, and mission-relevant data solutions.

Skills

Work Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field; or possess equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum of 72 months of related experience aligned to the position requirements.
Demonstrated experience building end-to-end data and analytics solutions in:
data integration
data transformation
data modeling
data warehousing
analytics
dashboarding and reporting
Strong experience with Army Vantage Platform or comparable Palantir Foundry-based enterprise analytics environments.
Experience with Power BI, including dashboard development, semantic modeling, data shaping, DAX, and enterprise reporting.
Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, relational databases, and SQL development for reporting and analytics.
Experience analyzing and transforming data using ETL/ELT techniques and platform-native data workflows.
Understanding of data governance, authoritative data sourcing, data lineage, and data stewardship principles.
Demonstrated understanding of database architecture design patterns and the complete application development and analytics lifecycle.
Ability to design solutions that provide meaningful, accurate, and mission-relevant business intelligence outputs.
Experience collaborating with analytics teams, application teams, and solution architects in a secure DoW environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong business acumen, exceptional interpersonal capabilities, and close attention to detail.

Experience building or maintaining data products, pipelines, and analytical workflows within Army Vantage.
Experience with Palantir Foundry concepts such as data pipelines, ontology-backed data products, lineage, governed access, and operational analytics workflows.
Experience integrating or consuming Army Vantage data within Power BI or similar enterprise visualization platforms.
Experience supporting data solutions for Army, DoW, readiness, logistics, financial, or operational mission sets.
Familiarity with agile delivery methodologies and iterative analytics development.

Chino is an open-pit copper mining complex located 15 miles from the historic mining community of Silver City in southwestern New Mexico. unior Geologist, Scientist or Pre-Construction Sampler
, where you’ll gain hands-on field experience and build practical skills on projects across Pennsylvania. Candidates in the greater Williamsport, PA area are encouraged to apply.

Conduct water, soil, and/or air sampling, site inspections, and other general field services independently and as part of a field team.
Capture clear, legible, accurate, and legally-defensible field documentation using established documentation procedures in both handwritten and software-based collection methods.
Calibrate andmaintain a variety of field equipment.
Prepare project documentation such as client reports, landowner reports, summary tables, photo logs, and maps.
Build professional working relationships with team members, subcontractors, clients, and regulatory agencies.
Follow all GES and client safety protocols and promptly communicate any safety concerns .
Support a range of field and office tasks as assigned by the field services manager, project manager, or supervisor.

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Environmental Science, or a related discipline. Internship, academic fieldwork, or 1+ years of relevant experience is welcome.
Residing in or near Williamsport, PA.
Ability to stay organized, manage time effectively, and produce high-quality, legally-defensible work while continuing to learn and grow in the role.
Work independently, in remote areas, with minimal supervision.
Commitment to following GES and client health, safety, security, and environmental standards in all activities.
Willingness to complete initial and annual OSHA HAZWOPER training and work safely while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Strong communication, teamwork, analytical, organizational, writing, and client service skills, with a willingness to ask questions and learn from feedback.

Ability to clearly and professionally communicate with private landowners, community members, and various stakeholders.
Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel; experience with Outlook, Virtual Meeting Platforms (ex., Teams), and other Microsoft Office tools is a plus.

Hadrian is building autonomous factories that help aerospace and defense companies manufacture rockets, satellites, jets, and ships up to 10x faster and up to 2x cheaper. We’re accelerating our mission with the launch of Factory 3 in Mesa, Arizona, a 290,000-square-foot facility creating 350 new jobs. We are expanding rapidly to support thousands of future hires, launching Hadrian Maritime to expand into naval production, and introducing a Factory-as-a-Service model that delivers complete systems instead of individual parts.

Hadrian is backed by leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, and Andreessen Horowitz, our fast-growing team is united around reindustrializing American manufacturing for the 21st century and beyond.

The Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and mission-driven People Data Analyst to join our People team. In this role, you’ll be the connective tissue between People Systems, Data Engineering, and People leadership, translating raw People and business data into the insights that shape how we hire, organize, and grow.

You’ll partner closely with our People Systems Engineer and Data Engineering team to help define the data model that underpins our People stack, and you’ll own turning that foundation into dashboards, reports, and analysis that recruiting, People leadership, and the broader business leadership team rely on to make decisions.

This is a build-from-the-ground-up opportunity: you won’t inherit a mature analytics function with years of dashboards and definitions already in place. You’ll help define what “good” looks like, the metrics that matter, the data model that supports them, and the reporting infrastructure that scales with a hypergrowth company. You’ll also help define how AI augments this work, from automating recurring reporting to building natural-language interfaces over People data in partnership with People Systems.

What You’ll Do

Design and build dashboards and self-serve reporting (e.g. in Tableau, Superset) once the underlying data infrastructure is in place, and own their accuracy and adoption going forward
Define and standardize core People metrics time-to-fill, attrition, span of control, headcount vs. plan, and similar in partnership with People leadership
Translate business questions from People and Recruiting leadership, and executive stakeholders into clear analytical approaches, and deliver insights that directly inform decisions
Partner with the People Systems Engineer and Data Engineering team to define and evolve the People data model
Connect People data to broader business metrics (e.g. headcount vs. revenue or production output, productivity, cost per hire relative to business growth) to give business leadership a complete picture of how people investment tracks with company performance
Partner with People Systems to identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI and natural language interfaces to make People data more accessible; helping non-technical stakeholders query and explore data without needing to build a new report each time
Own data quality and governance for People analytics; establishing definitions, validating accuracy, and ensuring leadership can trust the numbers without having to double-check them
Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses (e.g. attrition drivers, hiring funnel efficiency, organizational design) that go beyond standard reporting to answer emerging business questions

What We’re Looking For

6+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or people analytics, with a track record of delivering insights that influenced real business or People decisions
Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly in a modern data warehouse (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) to build and maintain your own queries and data models, rather than relying solely on pre-built tables
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in a BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, Superset including the underlying data modeling, not just the visualization layer
Experience partnering with engineering or data engineering teams to define data models and requirements - you can speak both “business question” and “data model” fluently
Demonstrated experience with core People/HR metrics and the employee lifecycle including recruiting funnel, headcount planning, attrition, compensation, performance and how they’re typically modeled
Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment — you can define your own roadmap in partnership with stakeholders rather than waiting for fully-scoped requirements

What Will Set You Apart

Direct experience partnering with a People Systems or engineering function to define a Peopledata model from the ground up
Experience with Rippling or similar HRIS platforms, and familiarity with how ATS, finance, and workforce data typically integrate with HR systems
Experience using AI tools (e.g. LLM-powered analysis, natural language querying over structured data, AI-assisted reporting) to scale analytics work and reduce manual reporting burden
Experience supporting People analytics in manufacturing, defense, or other complex multi- population environments (e.g. exempt and non-exempt populations across multiple sites)
Prior experience as the first or founding People analytics hire at a high-growth company, building reporting infrastructure rather than maintaining an existing one

Assist in integrating GIS technology with enterprise applications to improve workflow automation, data accessibility, reporting, and decision-making processes.

We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience and exemplify this through the makeup of our team at all levels. Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, such as Portal for ArcGIS, ArcGIS Server, enterprise service publishing, and content management, is highly preferred.
Ability to communicate technical GIS concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience evaluating existing policies, procedures, and objectives, and recommending changes for improvement.

Conduct research to locate and obtain existing databases.
Gather, analyze, and integrate spatial data and determine how best the information can be displayed using GIS.

Analyze spatial data for geographic statistics to incorporate into documents and reports.
Use principles of cartography to manipulate map layouts and associated symbology characteristics while integrating the use of correct coordinate systems, topography, data layers, north arrows, scale bars, and legends while creating aesthetically pleasing map designs.
Analyze geographic relationships among varying types of data.

Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline, knowledge and awareness.
Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
Additional duties as required.

Candidates need to be effective verbal and nonverbal communicators. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, etc.) as well as experience with ArcGIS is required. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, specifically InDesign, preferred. Desire to acquire AICP and/or GISP Certification (when professional experience minimums have been satisfied) preferred, but not required. All candidates are required to have the ability to pass a security/background check and security clearance investigation.

Knowledge of the philosophies, principals, practices & techniques of federal, urban, regional and/or facilities planning.
Knowledge of principles, methodology, and practices of research, data collection, and interviews.
Knowledge of planning disciplines and principles such as urban design, environmental and resiliency planning, military planning, economic development, or land use.
Knowledge of Global Positioning System (GPS) for field data collection, measuring, mapping, drafting, data conversion, and data manipulation.
Understanding of geodatabase structure and capabilities.
Advanced English language skills, both written and verbal, to include technical writing/editing experience and a demonstrated ability to write, edit, and deliver planning content.
Ability to create, read, analyze, and interpret technical material, financial reports, and legal documents.
Creative problem-solving skills to gather relevant information to solve less well-defined planning problems.
Ability to support planning workshops remotely or in person.
Ability to work on several projects or issues simultaneously.
Excellent interpersonal skills for facilitating relationships with elected/appointed officials or other decision-makers.
Bachelor's Degree in Geography, Planning, Landscape Architecture, or a related field.

Proven ability to produce high-quality reports and presentations for senior leadership.
Strong skills in preparing and presenting reports and project documentation.

Analyze business requirements, functional requirements, and data specifications to design and develop scalable data and analytics solutions.
Design, build, and maintain data pipelines, curated data assets, analytical models, and reporting solutions within the Army Vantage Platform.
Develop and support dashboards, reports, workflows, and operational data products for mission and business users.
Leverage Power BI to create visualizations, dashboards, and executive-level reporting solutions using trusted and governed data sources.
Perform data transformation, cleansing, normalization, and enrichment across structured and semi-structured data sources.
Design and implement logical and physical data models that support reporting, analysis, and operational use cases.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, procedures, and transformations to support data integration and reporting requirements.
Troubleshoot data pipelines, analytics workflows, dashboards, and platform issues, including timely resolution of production problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, acquire, validate, and govern data from multiple authoritative sources.
Support data quality, data lineage, data governance, and traceability requirements across analytics solutions.
Prepare, model, visualize, and analyze data to provide meaningful reporting and decision-support capabilities aligned to customer and mission needs.
Incorporate DoW security requirements, access controls, and data protection measures into analytics and modernization efforts.
Participate in architecture discussions, solution reviews, and platform improvement efforts related to Army Vantage, Power BI, SQL-based systems, and enterprise data environments.
Develop, document, and implement data models for transactional systems, reporting solutions, dashboards, and enterprise analytics products.
Produce clear technical documentation, user guidance, and solution artifacts to support sustainment and knowledge transfer.
Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and deliver clear, accurate, and mission-relevant data solutions.

Skills

Work Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field; or possess equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum of 72 months of related experience aligned to the position requirements.
Demonstrated experience building end-to-end data and analytics solutions in:
data integration
data transformation
data modeling
data warehousing
analytics
dashboarding and reporting
Strong experience with Army Vantage Platform or comparable Palantir Foundry-based enterprise analytics environments.
Experience with Power BI, including dashboard development, semantic modeling, data shaping, DAX, and enterprise reporting.
Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, relational databases, and SQL development for reporting and analytics.
Experience analyzing and transforming data using ETL/ELT techniques and platform-native data workflows.
Understanding of data governance, authoritative data sourcing, data lineage, and data stewardship principles.
Demonstrated understanding of database architecture design patterns and the complete application development and analytics lifecycle.
Ability to design solutions that provide meaningful, accurate, and mission-relevant business intelligence outputs.
Experience collaborating with analytics teams, application teams, and solution architects in a secure DoW environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong business acumen, exceptional interpersonal capabilities, and close attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or maintaining data products, pipelines, and analytical workflows within Army Vantage.
Experience with Palantir Foundry concepts such as data pipelines, ontology-backed data products, lineage, governed access, and operational analytics workflows.
Experience integrating or consuming Army Vantage data within Power BI or similar enterprise visualization platforms.
Experience supporting data solutions for Army, DoW, readiness, logistics, financial, or operational mission sets.
Familiarity with agile delivery methodologies and iterative analytics development.
